for each patient, calculate the frequency of mutations in terms of: A->C, A->G, A->T, C->A, C->G, C->T, CC->TT.  `->` indicates the substitution mutation. The patterns can be found by comparing reference allele and sequencing results of allele of the tumor sample. Save the results as pd.DataFrame named `substitution_ratios`, its format should be like

| Tumor_Sample_Barcode   |        A>C |       A>G |       A>T |       C>A |        C>G |      C>T |     CC>TT |   Others |
|:-----------------------|-----------:|----------:|----------:|----------:|-----------:|---------:|----------:|---------:|
| CSCC-1-T               | 0.0077821  | 0.0389105 | 0.0311284 | 0.167315  | 0.0311284  | 0.163424 | 0         | 0.560311 |
| CSCC-10-T              | 0.00854473 | 0.0149533 | 0.0136182 | 0.0154873 | 0.00774366 | 0.401335 | 0.0259012 | 0.512417 |

record.answer:
{"reference_answer": "import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the data
data_mutations = pd.read_csv('/workdir/data_mutations.csv')

# Define a function to determine the type of substitution
def determine_substitution(ref, alt):
    if ref == alt:
        return None
    substitution = f"{ref}>{alt}"
    if substitution in ["A>C", "A>G", "A>T", "C>A", "C>G", "C>T", "CC>TT"]:
        return substitution
    return "Others"

# Apply the function to determine the type of substitution for each mutation
data_mutations['Substitution1'] = data_mutations.apply(lambda row: determine_substitution(row['Reference_Allele'], row['Tumor_Seq_Allele1']), axis=1)
data_mutations['Substitution2'] = data_mutations.apply(lambda row: determine_substitution(row['Reference_Allele'], row['Tumor_Seq_Allele2']), axis=1)

# Combine the substitutions into a single column
data_mutations['Substitution'] = data_mutations['Substitution1'].combine_first(data_mutations['Substitution2'])

# Drop rows with no substitution
data_mutations = data_mutations.dropna(subset=['Substitution'])

# Calculate the ratio of each type of substitution for each patient
substitution_ratios = data_mutations.groupby(['Tumor_Sample_Barcode', 'Substitution']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
substitution_ratios = substitution_ratios.div(substitution_ratios.sum(axis=1), axis=0)

# Plot the ratio of each type of substitution for each patient
substitution_ratios.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, figsize=(12, 8))
plt.title('Ratio of Each Type of Gene Substitution Mutation for Each Patient')
plt.ylabel('Ratio')
plt.xlabel('Patient')
plt.legend(title='Substitution', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig("substitution_ratios.png")
plt.show()
", "test_cases": "assert abs(substitution_ratios['Others'].sum() - 19.924578840910613) < 1e-8

assert abs(substitution_ratios['A>C'].sum() - 0.34981164110408886) < 1e-8


assert abs(substitution_ratios['C>T'].sum() - 14.54864891595078) < 1e-8


assert abs(substitution_ratios['C>G'].sum() - 0.7529763077579285) < 1e-8


assert abs(substitution_ratios['C>A'].sum() - 1.1911024470062916) < 1e-8"}
